title: Authors' explanations of their mods' findings
description: data/explanations.json: by the index's key for a mod (host:owner/repo), then by finding, the explanation its author gave and the index approved. It is the author's word, not the index's, and is shown as theirs. An empty object until an explanation is approved.

by.description: The GitHub login that wrote it

at.description: When these words were first approved

release.description: The release it was written for

covers.description: What the release held of the finding when approved: a later jar reaching past it is no longer covered
